sn12.43:1.2: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the origin and the passing away of suffering.
sn12.43:1.3: Listen to that and attend closely, I will speak.”
sn12.43:2.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is the origin of suffering?
sn12.43:2.2: In dependence on the eye and forms, eye-consciousness arises. The meeting of the three is contact.
sn12.43:2.3: With contact as condition, feeling comes to be;
sn12.43:2.5: This is the origin of suffering.
sn12.43:3.1: “In dependence on the ear and sounds …
sn12.43:3.2: In dependence on the nose and odours …
sn12.43:3.3: In dependence on the tongue and tastes …
sn12.43:3.4: In dependence on the body and tactile objects …
sn12.43:3.5: In dependence on the mind and mental phenomena, mind-consciousness arises. The meeting of the three is contact.
sn12.43:3.6: With contact as condition, feeling comes to be;
sn12.43:3.8: This is the origin of suffering.
sn12.43:4.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is the passing away of suffering?
sn12.43:4.2: In dependence on the eye and forms, eye-consciousness arises. The meeting of the three is contact.
sn12.43:4.3: With contact as condition, feeling comes to be;
sn12.43:4.5: But with the remainderless fading away and cessation of that same craving comes cessation of clinging;
sn12.43:4.6: with the cessation of clinging, cessation of existence;
sn12.43:4.7: with the cessation of existence, cessation of birth;
sn12.43:4.8: with the cessation of birth, aging-and-death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, displeasure, and despair cease.
sn12.43:4.9: Such is the cessation of this whole mass of suffering.
sn12.43:4.10: This is the passing away of suffering.
sn12.43:5.1: “In dependence on the ear and sounds …
sn12.43:5.5: In dependence on the mind and mental phenomena, mind-consciousness arises. The meeting of the three is contact.
sn12.43:5.6: With contact as condition, feeling comes to be;
sn12.43:5.8: But with the remainderless fading away and cessation of that same craving comes cessation of clinging …
sn12.43:5.11: with the cessation of birth, aging-and-death, sorrow, lamentation, pain, displeasure, and despair cease.
sn12.43:5.12: Such is the cessation of this whole mass of suffering.
sn12.43:5.13: This is the passing away of suffering.”
